title: Oven Roasted Venezuelan Banana Bake
description: A mustardy and silky Venezuelan dish featuring fried ripe bananas, wood-fired-bake style, nut-free-friendly, perfect for a cozy dessert. This recipe is a twist on traditional Venezuelan cuisine, using oven roasting to mimic the wood-fired flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the brown sugar, unsalted butter, Dijon mustard, large eggs, vanilla extract, cinnamon powder, and salt until well combined.
Add the fried ripe bananas to the bowl and toss until they are evenly coated with the sugar mixture.
Transfer the banana mixture to a 9x9 inch baking dish and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the Oven Roasted Venezuelan Banana Bake warm, garnished with additional cinnamon powder if desired.
This dish can be served as a dessert or a snack.
To enhance the wood-fired flavor, cook the bananas in a skillet over medium heat for 2-3 minutes on each side before baking.
Let the dish cool completely before refrigerating or freezing for later use.
